name: Synty
summary: Stylized 3D environments, characters, interface packs and animations from Synty Studios.
licenseNote: Licenses and supported engines vary by product and storefront. Source files and engine projects must be checked on the exact pack.

watch.note: Automated permission must be established from the store terms before fetching its catalog.

name: Kenney
summary: Free 2D sprites, 3D models, UI, textures and audio for game development.
licenseNote: Game assets on the asset pages are CC0. Tool and other product licenses are separate; verify the pack's included license.

watch.note: Existing paced public-index importer; robots and product/archive license checks still apply.

name: Quaternius
summary: 3D game asset packs spanning characters, animations, props and environments.
licenseNote: The current Quaternius Asset License (QAL) permits commercial projects but restricts standalone redistribution. Older CC0 labels must not be assumed to apply to new downloads.

watch.note: Public index links only. Resolve QAL versus older CC0 claims on the exact release; no unlicensed media copying.

name: NatureManufacture
summary: Nature environments and terrain systems, with product editions for Unity and Unreal Engine.
licenseNote: Check the exact Unity or Fab edition, commercial license, engine version and render pipeline before adding a product.

watch.note: Official catalog/news links only; marketplace prices require a separate permitted product check.

name: polyperfect
summary: Low-poly environment and character packs, animated animals, interfaces and game systems.
licenseNote: Verify the specific marketplace edition, license and included engine files. A publisher's overall engine support is not proof for every pack.

watch.note: Official product links only; no private storefront or download API.

name: KayKit
summary: Kay Lousberg's modular low-poly environments, character packs and character animations.
licenseNote: Verify the free and paid tiers separately. A source-file upgrade is not automatically part of the free download.

watch.note: Official index links only; follow the exact linked itch product to verify tier, price and license.

name: Infinity PBR
summary: Customizable 3D characters, monsters, environments, audio and Unity tools by Magic Pig Games.
licenseNote: Infinity PBR is a series by Magic Pig Games. Check each product's license, edition and documented Unity, Unreal or Godot support.

watch.note: Official product links only; displayed homepage prices do not establish a current marketplace promotion.

name: CraftPix
summary: Free and premium 2D sprites, tilesets, interfaces, icons and game art kits.
licenseNote: Check the exact product license and download requirements. Free assets do not make website artwork or descriptions freely reusable.

watch.note: Website terms restrict copying/retransmission. Use an approved feed or explicit permission before automated collection; do not scrape or rehost artwork.

name: Ansimuz
summary: Retro pixel-art characters, backgrounds, tilesets and effects by Luis Zuno.
licenseNote: Free, paid and expanded collections have different contents. Verify commercial terms and the actual minimum price per product.

watch.note: Official creator index only; robots/terms and product-specific price/license checks apply.

name: Pixel Frog
summary: Pixel-art characters, tilesets, objects and animated sprites, including the Pixel Adventure packs.
licenseNote: Pixel Adventure lists PNG artwork under CC0. Verify every other pack independently; a playable demo does not mean an engine project is included.

watch.note: Official creator index only; inspect an actual product page if the index does not expose useful metadata.
